## Governance Change Proposal

**Branch:** `gov/<short-name>` (e.g.,
`gov/charter-amendment-v2`)

**Compare URL:**
```
https://github.com/QSSLibrary/Team/compare/gov/<short-name>?template=governance.md
```

**Source content template:** `templates/proposal.md`
(for major changes) or direct edits (for minor
clarifications)

---

## What governance document is affected?

- [ ] `CHARTER.md`
- [ ] `GOVERNANCE.md`
- [ ] `governance/sponsorship.md`
- [ ] `governance/roles.md`
- [ ] `governance/evolution.md`
- [ ] `governance/working-groups.md`
- [ ] `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Other: [specify]

## Type of change

- [ ] **Amendment** — substantive change to
      existing text
- [ ] **Addition** — new section or new document
- [ ] **Clarification** — non-substantive wording
      improvement
- [ ] **Cross-reference fix** — broken or stale
      link
- [ ] **Decision log update** — recording a
      previous decision

## Summary

[What this PR changes]

## Motivation

[Why this change is needed]

## Authority

Per `governance/evolution.md` §6.1:

- **Routine governance changes** (Phase 1):
  project lead + both founder representatives
  (founder veto held)
- **Routine governance changes** (Phase 2+): TSC
  majority
- **Charter-level changes** (Phase 1): both
  founders
- **Charter-level changes** (Phase 2+): TSC
  unanimous + founder ratification

## Charter-level check

If this PR modifies `CHARTER.md`, additional
requirements apply:

- [ ] 14-day minimum public comment period
      (longer than the 7-day default for routine
      governance changes)
- [ ] Decision recorded in `CHARTER.md` §8
      decision log as a new version
- [ ] Both founders have ratified the change

## Process checklist

- [ ] I followed `templates/proposal.md` (for
      major changes)
- [ ] I have run the appropriate public comment
      period (7 days for governance, 14 days for
      charter)
- [ ] I have updated the affected document's
      decision log
- [ ] I have created or updated an ADR in
      `decisions/`
- [ ] I have updated all cross-references
